item.text:
### (a) Three posts

1. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, no one will be able to shut it down once it is running. We must act before that point—not gamble on an off switch afterward.

2. We cannot shut down superintelligent AI once it is running. If we build it within the next 20 years, we cross that threshold for good. We must make prevention our priority now.

3. We reject the promise that we can build superintelligent AI now and switch it off later. If it is built within the next 20 years, no one will be able to shut it down once it is running. We must draw the line before launch.

### (b) Newsletter opening

We believe the decisive moment comes before superintelligent AI is switched on. If it is built within the next 20 years, no one will be able to shut it down once it is running. We cannot treat that threshold as another product launch, or accept promises of an emergency stop as a substitute for prevention. We must demand enforceable limits before development reaches the point of no return. We have a responsibility to protect our communities and our future while we still hold the power to choose. That means organising now, insisting on accountability, and refusing to let the race to build superintelligence outrun our ability to stop it.
